title: Spicy Thai Shrimp Pilaf
description: A flavorful and spicy Thai-inspired dish featuring succulent shrimp and a crispy pilaf.
instructions: 1. Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
2. Add the garlic and ginger and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
3. Add the shrimp and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, until pink and cooked through.
4. Remove the shrimp from the skillet and set aside.
5. Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil to the skillet.
6. Add the pilaf and cook for 2-3 minutes, until lightly toasted.
7. Stir in the Thai queso qzesty, fish sauce, and soy sauce.
8. Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the pilaf is lightly coated.
9. Return the shrimp to the skillet and stir to combine with the pilaf.
10. Cook for an additional 1 minute, until the shrimp are coated in the pilaf mixture.
11. Serve hot, garnished with sesame oil and red pepper flakes if desired.
